# Kringkasting

> Kringkasting turns the podcasts of NRK, Norway's public broadcaster, into open RSS feeds, so they can be followed in any podcast app instead of only in NRK's own app. Each feed carries the show's complete episode archive. The service is free, open source (AGPL-3.0), self-hostable and not affiliated with NRK; all content belongs to NRK, and audio, video and artwork are streamed directly from NRK.

The website is in Norwegian (bokmål). Kringkasting does not select, rank or edit NRK's content: it offers a feed for every podcast, season and radio series NRK's API lists.

## Using it

- [Search for a podcast](https://kringkast.ing/): search by name, or paste a link to a podcast, season or episode from radio.nrk.no or the NRK app (Del → Kopier lenke). "Abonner" opens a chooser with podcast apps and an RSS copy option. On a computer, it also offers a QR code for mobile and shows only desktop-compatible app actions. Spotify does not support RSS feeds.
- [Feed address format](https://kringkast.ing/api/feeds/sentralbordet): `/api/feeds/{seriesId}` for a podcast or radio series, where seriesId is the slug in NRK's own address (radio.nrk.no/podkast/{seriesId}), and `/api/feeds/{seriesId}/sesong/{seasonId}` for a season NRK publishes as a show of its own.
- [Privacy](https://kringkast.ing/personvern): no accounts. The subscribe chooser does not store app choices or a history of podcasts sent to apps.

## What the feeds contain

- The full archive: older episodes are fetched in the background after a feed is first requested, so a new feed may start with only the latest episodes.
- Chapters ([Podcasting 2.0](https://podcasting2.org/) `podcast:chapters`) where NRK marks them.
- Video where NRK publishes it, as a `podcast:alternateEnclosure` with NRK's HLS stream; apps without video support play the audio.
- Some radio programs exist only as HLS streams, which not every podcast app can play.

## Source and self-hosting

- [Source code](https://github.com/matsbst/kringkasting): Go and SQLite in one container; started as a fork of [NRSS](https://github.com/olaven/nrss) by Olav Sundfør.
- [Self-hosting guide](https://github.com/matsbst/kringkasting/blob/main/docs/self-hosting.md): Docker Compose, NAS and Cloudron.
- [How NRK's API is used](https://github.com/matsbst/kringkasting/blob/main/docs/nrk-api-usage.md): caching and request limits that keep the load on NRK low.
